'''Robert Philippi''', a player from Utah, finished third at the [[2004 Utah State Championship]] on 31 July 2004 with Hidden Base on the Light Side and CCT-Scum on the Dark Side.<ref name="pcf-3588-51839">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=51839#51839 UPDATED!!!
